about the author
Peter Harrington holds Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in Electrical Engineering. He
worked for Intel Corporation for seven years in California and China. Peter holds five
U.S. patents and his work has been published in three academic journals. He is cur-
rently the chief scientist for Zillabyte Inc. Prior to joining Zillabyte, he was a machine
learning software consultant for two years. Peter spends his free time competing in
programming competitions and building 3D printers.
